title: What If Every Plane on Earth Was Grounded?

scenes.text: What if every plane on Earth was grounded? The sky itself would change within three days.
Every jet leaves a trail of ice crystals called a contrail, and those trails can spread into thin clouds.
In September 2001, American flights stopped for three days. The gap between daytime highs and nighttime lows grew by about 1.8 degrees Celsius.
It was the biggest swing in thirty years of records, and scientists linked at least part of it to the missing contrails.
Contrails normally block some sunshine by day and trap some heat at night, so without them days run warmer and nights run cooler.
So the planes weren't just crossing the sky. They were quietly writing on the weather itself.
